responsibility: Declares `DesugarTryBlock`, the helper responsible for rewriting Rust `try` block expressions into simpler AST form before lowering. The header provides the static entry point that replaces a `TryExpr` subtree in place and the private desugaring routine used to build the replacement expression, defining the interface for this specific expression-syntax transformation.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of the `rust-desugar-try-block` pair, exposing the static in-place rewrite entry point and private helper signature; unlike the `.cc` file, it does not construct the replacement `Try::from_ok` block or perform the body checks.
